angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 633,435 km at 125.35 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.9779 +/- 0.0088 mas (same row, RUWE 0.85): 125.35 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.9105 +/- 0.0154 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1444 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 633,435 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.9513 +/- 0.0299 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1444 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5460 +/- 66 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1444 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1444 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1444.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.498, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1444 (pscomppars): spectral type G, from Brinkman et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..109B/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1444 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.146 dex, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1444 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.17587, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1444 (pscomppars): age 3.8 Gyr, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1444 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Dai et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162...62D/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
